newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Aug 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Aug 18.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Monday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Government administrative reform panel is considering privatisation of mail, postal savings and postal insurance services.
-- Foreign securities firms expanding prior to Japan's 'Big Bang' market liberalisation.
-- Construction Ministry will not ask local governments to pay back subsidies on abandoned dam projects.
-- Transport Ministry's Aircraft Accident Investigation Committee to issue safety guidance to Indonesia.
-- APEC energy ministers to call for building natural gas pipeline network in Asia.
